fields.name: Usage
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}start` — turn alerts back on. Your tracking was kept while alerts were off.

If the bot stopped your alerts because you went over the alert limit, `{{prefix}}start` turns them back on too. If the bot disabled your account instead, see `{{prefix}}help poracle`.

fields.name: {{#if userIsAdmin}}Admins{{/if}}
fields.value: {{#if userIsAdmin}}`{{prefix}}start user:<id>` — resume alerts for another user. In a registered channel, `{{prefix}}start` resumes the channel.{{/if}}
